instruction: Cinematic film still, medium shot. Inside a modern office, the man in the grey patterned blazer (R2) on the left and the man in the light blue sweater (R1) on the right stand facing each other in profile. They clasp hands in a firm handshake in front of a large window overlooking a hazy city street. Cool, diffused daylight illuminates the scene, creating a muted color palette.
